title: Mihály Hentér to Ferenc Rákóczi II, 8 July 1707

steps.what: Used the authenticated DECODE session and cookie to retrieve the full-resolution recto and verso of R496 and the sibling records R533 and R534.
Located Benedek Láng's identification of fols. 38, 40, and 46 as Hentér's three 1707 monoalphabetic letters (C.Hen.01-03).
Discovered and read the interlinear Hungarian decipherment on R496, recovering the Belgrade pasha's proposed military support, Hentér's audience negotiations, and the request to free a captive.
Checked the closing formula against R533: wi6xi2i4 = Felséged, with the same substitution recurring across the three Hentér letters.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): the interlinear decipherment copied verbatim from NOTES into texts/mnl-g15-d80-f38_decryption.md; no cipher transcription exists (project work).

outcome.method_basis: A contemporary interlinear Hungarian decipherment covers the cipher on the target folio itself (MNL OL G 15, fol. 38), unflagged by DECODE R496; it was read and checked against the sibling R533 closing formula.
outcome.notes: The historical decipherment covers the full cipher and makes the message's substance clear. About one fifth of a publication-quality diplomatic transcription remains uncertain because the interlinear hand overlaps the cipher, not because the cryptographic values are unknown.

texts.label: R496, Hentér to Rákóczi, Constantinople 8 July 1707
texts.summary: Mihály Hentér, Rákóczi's envoy at Constantinople, to Ferenc Rákóczi II, 8 July 1707: the pasha of Belgrade received Rákóczi's gift favourably and offered troops, gunpowder and grain if Rákóczi sent six or seven thousand men against the Serbs; Hentér pressed for the deputation to be heard by the grand vizier, whose audience was delayed amid confusion in the capital; he closes with a request about the liberation of a captive.
texts.note: Decryption = the interlinear Hungarian, normalized, copied from NOTES.md; some middle clauses are uncertain or unread (need a Hungarian palaeographer). No transcription of the cipher signs (project work); the archive does not allow the scans to be republished.

prior.where: Interlinear plaintext on the target folio itself; DECODE R496 failed to flag it.

human: Provided authenticated access to the DECODE images.
